SETTINGS.TITLE: Conversations Panel
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Green: conversations already assigned to an agent. Orange: conversations in the queue, with no agent. Red: conversations in the queue with no agent for longer than the limit below (counted from the customer's last message). Who can see the panel is set in the Custom Role (permission "See the Conversations Panel"); administrators always can.
SETTINGS.ORANGE_UNTIL: Queue becomes "waiting for a long time" after
SETTINGS.RED_HINT: Up to that time the conversation stays in "Waiting in the queue"; after it, it turns red.
SETTINGS.LIST_LIMIT_HELP: How many conversations each card shows when opened.
SETTINGS.SOUND: Play a sound when a conversation enters red (each person can turn it on or off in the panel)
